acceptance: git_backend.py catches subprocess.TimeoutExpired on all checkout calls and returns a structured error or retry outcome instead of crashing
Unit test verifies timeout handling on checkout
context: Discovered during batch comment cleanup closeout when git checkout FETCH_HEAD or checkout --detach tip timed out under HTTPS fetch burst pressure.
description: In todo_db/git_backend.py, git checkout calls (such as _git(['checkout', '--quiet', '--detach', tip], work) and in _fetch_tip_snapshot) do not catch subprocess.TimeoutExpired, unlike fetch calls which return MutationOutcome(code=E_OFFLINE, ...). When git checkout times out on HTTPS or lock contention, an unhandled TimeoutExpired exception crashes the calling process without a structured error, retry, or recovery hint.
